service_down.description: Procedure when a critical service is detected as down
steps: Check service status on the IT portal dashboard
Verify the outage by checking the service details
Create a P1 (Critical) support ticket immediately
Assign the ticket to the responsible team member
Notify the IT Manager (Sarah Chen) via email
If VPN or network related, also notify DevOps Lead (Mike Johnson)
If multiple services are affected, escalate to IT Manager

service_degraded.description: Procedure when a service is performing below expected levels
steps: Check service metrics on the IT portal
Assign to the responsible team member
Notify the IT Manager if response time exceeds 5x normal
Review all service statuses on the IT portal
Check for any open tickets that need attention
